text: Heroic: Underrot is a dungeon achievement earned for defeating the Unbound Abomination in Underrot on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Tol Dagor is a dungeon achievement earned for defeating Overseer Korgus in Tol Dagor on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: The Temple of Sethraliss is a dungeon achievement earned for restoring the Avatar of Sethraliss in the Temple of Sethraliss on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Shrine of the Storm is a dungeon achievement earned for defeating Vol'zith the Whisperer in Shrine of the Storm on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Hessir is a sethrak cooking trainer located in the Sanctuary of the Devoted in Vol'dun.
The Hex-Cleansed Charm is a quest reward from The Witchqueen.
Heroic: Crucible of Storms is a dungeon & raids achievement earned by defeating The Restless Cabal and Uu'nat, Harbinger of the Void in Crucible of Storms on Heroic difficultly.
Heroic: Sanguine Depths is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating General Kaal in Sanguine Depths on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Crestfall is an expansion features achievement earned by achieving victory in an expedition to Crestfall on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Dread Chain is an expansion feature achievement earned by achieving victory in an expedition to Dread Chain on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Havenswood is an expansion features achievement earned by achieving victory in an expedition to Havenswood on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Jorundall is an expansion features achievement earned by achieving victory in an expedition to Jorundall on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Molten Cay is an expansion features achievement earned by achieving victory in an expedition to Molten Cay on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Rotting Mire is an expansion features achievement earned by achieving victory in an expedition to Rotting Mire on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Skittering Hollow is an expansion features achievement earned by achieving victory in an expedition to Skittering Hollow on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Snowblossom Village is an expansion features achievement earned by achieving victory in an expedition to Snowblossom Village on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Verdant Wilds is an expansion features achievement earned by achieving victory in an expedition to Verdant Wilds on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Whispering Reef is an expansion features achievement earned by achieving victory in an expedition to Whispering Reef on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: War is Hell is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing the Battle for Stromgarde on Heroic Difficulty.
Heroic: War for the Shore is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing the Battle for Darkshore on Heroic Difficulty.
Heroic: Tour of War is an expansion feature achievement earned by defeating the following enemy commanders in the Battle for Stromgarde on heroic difficulty:
Heroic: Spires of Ascension is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Devos, Paragon of Doubt in Spires of Ascension on Heroic difficulty or higher
Heroic: The Necrotic Wake is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Nalthor the Rimebinder in the Necrotic Wake on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Castle Nathria is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating the following bosses on Heroic difficulty.
Heroic: De Other Side is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Mueh'zala in De Other Side on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Halls of Atonement is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating the Lord Chamberlain in the Halls of Atonement on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Mists of Tirna Scithe is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Tred'ova in Mists of Tirna Scithe on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Plaguefall is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Margrave Stradama in Plaguefall on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Theater of Pain is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Mordretha, the Endless Empress in Theater of Pain on Heroic difficutly or higher.
Hershak's Heavy Legguards drops from Quartermaster Hershak in Socrethar's Rise in .

The Heroic Champion of the Chosen Dead is a mannequin that appears in the Hall of Glory in the Trial of Valor after Odyn is defeated. It showcases the heroic mode versions of the Trial of Valor armor sets, with the displayed armor set differing depending on the player's class. The sets for the other difficulties are displayed by the Aspiring Champion, Champion, and Mythical Champion of the Chosen Dead.
Hewn Protectors are stoneborn located in Dominance Keep in Revendreth.
Heron Net is provided for Ember Court: Glimpse of the Wilds.
Heroic: Sanctum of Domination is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating every boss in the Sanctum of Domination on Heroic difficulty.
Heroic: Castle Nathria Guild Run is a guild dungeons & raid achievement earned by defeating a series of bosses in Castle Nathria on Heroic difficulty while in a guild group.
Heroic: Sanctum of Domination Guild Run is a guild dungeons & raid achievement earned by defeating all bosses in the Sanctum of Domination on Heroic difficulty or higher while in a guild group.
Heroic: Sepulcher of the First Ones is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating the bosses in Sepulcher of the First Ones on Heroic difficulty.

Heroic Sepulcher of the First Ones Guild Run is a guild dungeons & raid achievement earned by defeating the bosses in Sepulcher of the First Ones on Heroic difficulty or higher while in a guild group.
Hershey is a retriever found next to Xena, David Luong, and Steven Dowling in Brill in Tirisfal Glades.
Heroines are pandaren located in Scrollkeeper's Sanctum in the Temple of the Jade Serpent. They've been brought to life by the Corrupted Scroll.
Hessethiash's Poorly Hidden Treasure is a chest found next to an Old Scroll and, likely the corpse of Hessethiash in Hessethiash' Hollow atop the War Creche in the Forbidden Reach.
Heroic: Brackenhide Hollow is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Decatriarch Wratheye in Brackenhide Hollow on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Halls of Infusion is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating the Primal Tsunami in Halls of Infusion on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Neltharus is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Warlord Sargha in Neltharus on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Ruby Life Pools is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Kyrakka and Erkhart Stormvein in Ruby Life Pools on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: The Azure Vault is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Umbrelskul in The Azure Vault on Heroic difficulty or higher.
__NOTOC__ Heroic: The Nokhud Offensive is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Balakar Khan in the Nokhud Offensive on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Uldaman: Legacy of Tyr is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Chrono-Lord Deios in Uldaman: Legacy of Tyr on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heroic: Vault of the Incarnates is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating all bosses on Heroic difficulty in Vault of the Incarnates.

Heroic: Vault of the Incarnates Guild Run is a guild dungeons & raid achievement earned by defeating the following bosses in Vault of the Incarnates on Heroic difficulty or higher while in a guild group.
Herrod is a draenei jewelcrafting trainer located in Camp Antonidas in the Azure Span.

Hessethiash's Hollow is a small cave just to the southwest of the Old Weyrn Grounds in south-central Forbidden Reach. Some Scalecrawler Beetles and Mature Scalecrawlers occasionally wander in, and the Book of Arcane Entities is floating in the back of the cave. It requires a Glowing Crystal Bookmark to interact with.
Heroic Dungeon Delver's Trophy Chest is a quest reward from Fighting is Its Own Reward, the weekly heroic dungeon quest from Kemora at Azure Archives Annex in Valdrakken.
Heroic Dungeon Delver's Trophy Crest is a quest reward from Fighting is Its Own Reward, the weekly heroic dungeon quest from Kemora at Azure Archives Annex in Valdrakken.

The term hide can mean two things: # A type of skin item usually gathered with the Skinning profession from a skinnable corpse and usable as an ingredient for mostly Leatherworking recipes. # To try to conceal or make hidden. Also called Stealth.

Hidden Enemies is the first in a small Horde quest line that involves infiltrating the Burning Blade clan at the request of Thrall. In this quest, players must acquire a token identifying the bearer as a ranking member of the demon cult.
High Elven Swordsmen were the melee units of the high elves of Quel'Thalas in Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos. They were produced at the High Elven Barracks.
Hi-Impact Mithril Slugs were ammunition that could be used in guns and were created by engineers.

Hidden Knowledge is a short story in the World of Warcraft Official Strategy Guide. A human warlock enters a tavern in Goldshire, making sure its inhabitants assumed he is just another mage. When nobody knew or cared what he was doing he snuck into the back room, and down into basement in order to find another warlock that could teach him secret knowledge. After making sure no one else had discovered them he began his training.
__NOTOC__ High Executor Derrington is a Forsaken quest giver located at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades. He welcomes Horde adventurers to the area and sends them on quests into the Plaguelands.

High Executor Darthalia is a Forsaken quest giver located at Southpoint Gate in the Hillsbrad Foothills. She commands the Forsaken forces from her command post. Her job is to stop the spread of humans and other Alliance members in Hillsbrad. Before his betrayal, Darthalia was under the direct command of the dreadlord Varimathras and Sylvanas Windrunner. She was previously located in Tarren Mill organizing the war against the humans. During the Legion Invasions, Darthalia defended the Gate.
The High Elven Barracks is the high elves' primary troop production building. Trains High Elven Swordsmen, High Elven Archers, Ballistae and Dragon Hawks.
__NOTOC__ High Elf Rangers are high elf guards located in Allerian Stronghold in Terokkar Forest. They are probably the same rangers that left with Alleria Windrunner and the Alliance Expedition.

__NOTOC__ High Chief Winterfall is a furbolg found in Timbermaw Post in Winterspring. Donova Snowden sends adventurers to kill High Chief Winterfall, should they be successful, they eventually find his Crudely-Written Log and hand it to Donova. Killing him awards 40 reputation with Timbermaw Hold.

High Executor Hadrec is a Forsaken located at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Following the Battle for Lordaeron, he led Horde reinforcement towards Tirisfal but was halted by the Alliance champions.

__NOTOC__ Hezrul Bloodmark is a centaur who patrols the Lushwater Oasis in the Northern Barrens with two Bloodguards. He is the leader of the Kolkar forces in the Barrens, and Regthar Deathgate wants his head.

High Botanist Freywinn is the second boss of the Botanica wing of Tempest Keep in the Netherstorm. He appears to be a herbalist and is probably in charge of the experiments the blood elves are conducting on the plants in the Botanica. It seems he at some point had time to write a comprehensive botany guide; Botanist's Field Guide.

Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania is a Forsaken quest giver located in just outside the Grim Guzzler in Blackrock Depths. Before the Cataclysm, she could be found in Kargath in Badlands. She is a member of the Kargath Expeditionary Force.

Muninn Magellas is a dwarf quest giver located in the Library in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. He is affiliated with the Explorers' League. He is committed to steering the League and gaining valuable insight on the mistakes of the past.
A hexxer (sometimes spelled hexer) is a type of a caster. There are troll, saurok and harpy hexxers.
High Apothecary Cloak is a reward from the Horde quest series Elixir of Agony (3) which started with Apothecary Lydon at Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

High Chief Stillpine is a furbolg quest giver located at Stillpine Hold in the draenei starting zone of Azuremyst Isle. He is the chieftain of the Stillpine furbolgs. The High Chief is one of the many who journey to Blood Watch to celebrate the hero of Bloodmyst and Azuremyst.

High Executor Mavren is a Forsaken quest giver located at Tranquillien in the Ghostlands. Sylvanas Windrunner appointed him to assist Dame Auriferous in defeating Dar'Khan Drathir because he used to fight the Scourge.

The Hidden Reef is a small water elemental temple located deep underwater off the northwestern coast of Bloodmyst Isle. It is where Alliance shaman go to talk to Aqueous, the lord of water elementals in the region, to start the quest Call of Water. The entire area is tainted with red water.

High Astromancer Solarian is a boss of the Eye in Tempest Keep. While she is a mage, she is notably attired in the warlock's tier 4 set Voidheart Raiment, likely due to the fact that she transforms into a massive voidwalker towards the end of her fight.
Hexx's Key drops from Vile Priestess Hexx in Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands.
The High Councillor's Cloak is a world drop from level 56-60 mobs.
Hexxer Staves drop from Shadowpine Hexxers in the Ghostlands.
in the TCG.]] Hierophants appear in World of Warcraft as either druids, for most of them, or followers of religion.

Most warlocks are of the hidden variety. Hidden warlocks are unwelcome in both the Alliance and the Horde. No one wants them around; they are evil beings who consort with demons. When the Horde discovers a hidden warlock in their midst, it is an unpleasant day for the warlock. Nevertheless, the call of the Burning Legion is strong, and members of both the Alliance and the Horde don the warlock's dark robes. They operate out of the basements and lurk in the alleyways, but still they exist, gripping their secrets with both hands. These hidden warlocks are more prevalent in the Horde, with both orcs and Forsaken (mostly) taking up the mantle. Hidden warlocks usually use spells that will more ea

The Hidden Reach is the name given to a secret entrance to Dire Maul East which bypasses the usual hazards of getting into the keep from its usual entrance. It is accessed by the Lariss Pavillion located in the forest area north of Camp Mojache. Along the western rim of the pavillion is a downward spiral ramp whose northern area has the door to The Hidden Reach. This door can only be accessed by use of the . Once open, there is a winding tunnel that goes down to an instance portal. Once crossed, the adventurer(s) will be in a corridor that leads to the easternmost portion of Dire Maul East. The area is guarded by Lashers and Satyrs. If one goes through the standard instance portal in the Bro
Hex Lord Malacrass is the fifth boss in Zul'Aman, the final obstacle before the raid can do battle with Zul'jin.
An item collection. This is not a true set. There are no bonuses if you wear more than one or all of this set.

__NOTOC__ High Chief Bristlelimb is a furbolg found on Bloodmyst Isle, in the northern-most camp of the Bristlelimb Enclave. He will only appear after you have killed a few of the furbolgs in that camp.
High Executioner Nuzrak moved to the entrance of Blackrock Depths after Cataclysm, leaving his previous post at Kargath in the Badlands. He executed the traitorous orc Grark Lorkrub.
Hidden Enemies is a small Horde questline that involves infiltrating the Burning Blade clan at the request of Thrall.

High Explorer (aka High Explorer of the Guild) is a title of honor or rank in the Explorers' Guild. Several members of the guild have or had this rank. There is evidence that High Explorer was also originally the title for the leader of the guild. It appears that more than one member can hold the title at the same time in recent years.
Hidalgo the Master Falconer is a human located in Explorers' League Outpost in Howling Fjord.

, leader of the Hidden Circle.]] The Hidden Circle is an Alliance rogue organization based in the Forlorn Cavern of Ironforge. The guild is currently led by Hulfdan Blackbeard, and was once investigated by agents of King Magni Bronzebeard who arrested several of its members. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, Hulfdan Blackbeard and a few members of the organization joined the ranks of the Uncrowned. Their members are in charge of training the apprentice thieves in Ironforge. When asked for their location, the Ironforge Guards stated that they often had trouble with Hulfdan.
Hierophant Cenius is a tauren druid located at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in the Borean Tundra.
__NOTOC__ High Executor Anselm is the leader of the Forsaken outpost of Vengeance Landing, the Horde's primary port of call in the Howling Fjord.
High-Shaman Rakjak is a wolvar quest giver and the leader of the wolvar at Frenzyheart Hill in Sholazar Basin.
__NOTOC__ Hierophant Thayreen is a night elf druid found at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills. She is there to study the failed world tree of Vordrassil.
The mouth of Hibernal Cavern is located in the Valley of Ancient Winters, between Brunnhildar Village and Dun Niffelem. It is infested with Ravenous Jormungar.
High Admiral "Shelly" Jorrik is a goblin located at Newman's Landing on the western coast of Dun Morogh. He is accompanied by two Booty Bay Bruisers.

Galvar Pureblood was a High Commander of the Scarlet Crusade during the period in which High General Abbendis formed the Scarlet Onslaught and sailed for Northrend. When the necropolis Acherus was moved into play against the Crusade, Galvar began assembling a host from Hearthglen and the surrounding lands. His plan was to unite with Abbendis' forces and drive back the death knights. Abbendis, however, was manipulated by Mal'Ganis under the guise of the Light into believing that Galvar and his forces stood no chance and would be slaughtered. After sending many Scarlet Couriers to try and warn the High Commander not to march to Tyr's Hand and join her in Northrend, Abbendis sailed for the froz

__NOTOC__ High Executor Wroth is the leader, and a quest giver, of Venomspite in Dragonblight. He is cruel and merciless in issuing kill orders. When the Torturer's Rod is given to him, he reveals that he had been a royal torturer of Lordaeron himself before undeath. He directs Horde adventurers to kill the Scarlet Onslaught forces at Onslaught Harbor.

Hidetrader Jun'ik is a jungle troll leatherworker who is ordered by Conqueror Krenna to collect worg hides. However, he attempts to substitute disguised grizzly hides for the worg hides in his belief being that there would never be enough worg hide for her troops. When his deception is discovered Krenna orders his leg broken. Her sister Gorgonna, unwilling to do the deed but seeking to make it look real, kicks him in the leg to make it look like she broke it.

High Captain Justin Bartlett is a human quest giver in Icecrown and the current commanding officer on the Alliance gunship Skybreaker. He saves Jaina Proudmoore and the group of players from the Lich King at the end of the Halls of Reflection.

The Hidden Hollow is a heavily guarded cave on the southern shore Onslaught Harbor, behind the Crimson Cathedral and harbor area, in Icecrown. Grand Admiral Barean Westwind, leader of the Scarlet Onslaught, resides in here alongside many Onslaught Darkweavers performing fel rituals. The rest of the Onslaught are forbidden from entering.

Hexil Garrot is a goblin vendor found in the Underbelly beneath Dalaran. Except Bartram Haller he is the only source of the Dalaran Knuckles. During the purge of Dalaran, he was cowering in fear behind armor stands.
Hexxer Ubungo is a Zandalari troll quest giver located in the Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

__NOTOC__ High Crusader Adelard can be found in the Argent Pavilion at the Argent Tournament Grounds. He, along with Crusader Silverdawn, offers daily quests to players who have earned the title . All of High Crusader Adelard's daily quests involve targeting important enemy leaders, such as Drottinn Hrothgar, leader of the sea vrykul at Hrothgar's Landing. During Death Rising, Adelard patrolled the grounds of the Tournament on horseback.
High Five: 1550 is a player vs. player achievement earned for 1550 personal rating in the 5v5 bracket of the arena.
High Five: 1750 is a player vs. player achievement earned for 1750 personal rating in the 5v5 bracket of the arena.
High Five: 2000 is a player vs. player achievement earned for 2000 personal rating in the 5v5 bracket of the arena.
High Five: 2200 is a player vs. player achievement earned for 2200 personal rating in the 5v5 bracket of the arena.
Hideous Plaguebringers are plague eruptors trying to stop the sanctifing of Crusaders' Pinnacle during The Battle For Crusaders' Pinnacle.

__NOTOC__ High Cultist Herenn is a high-ranking member of the Cult of the Damned. He can be found in the Hall of Repose, located at the Shaper's Terrace in Un'Goro Crater. He is standing with two Death's Hand Acolytes.
Hezrul's Head drops from Hezrul Bloodmark in the Northern Barrens.

The Hidden Passage is a long path and tunnel that leads from the Shadow Throne to a platform outside the Halls of Reflection. In order to escape the Lich King, the player must battle through waves of enemies raised by the Lich King in order to break through the ice walls he creates to halt the party's progress. Upon reaching the end of the passage, the players will be rescued by their faction's gunship (the Skybreaker for Alliance, Orgrim's Hammer for Horde) that will blast the exit to the outside balcony thus ending the encounter. The balcony platform is on a cliff above Angrathar the Wrathgate. In the center of the cavern where the Passage begins, a large saronite necropolis, greatly resem

__NOTOC__ High Elf Mage-Priests are high elves who appear in the Culling of Stratholme. First appearing outside of Stratholme, some of them, along with some Lordaeron Footmen, assist Arthas in his purging. They attack Risen Zombies, Stratholme Citizens and Stratholme Residents.

High Elf Sorceresses are high elves who appear in the Culling of Stratholme. They appear outside of Stratholme and like the Lordaeron Knights they do not assist Arthas during the purge. In the Deaths of Chromie, they appear with Arthas at the beginning of Stratholme.

High Apothecary Shana T'veen is a Forsaken quest giver in Silverpine Forest. She helps weaponize a new explosive strain of Forsaken Blight which would be used by the Forsaken forces during the Silverpine Forest storyline.
Hexed Dire Trolls were dire trolls being controlled by Zalazane on the Echo Isles during the Battle to reclaim the Echo Isles.
High Executor's Branding Iron is provided as an objective for Torture the Torturer.
Hieroglyphic Helm is a quest reward from The Grand Tablet (quest).
Hidden Stash contains some money and rarely the companion pet Mr. Grubbs.
The heroic version of Hide of Chromaggus was never made available, but would presumably have dropped from trash mobs in the heroic version of Blackwing Descent.
High Elf Pilgrims can be found standing around the Sunwell in Sunwell Plateau during The Purification of Quel'Delar.
__NOTOC__ High Cultist Azerynn is a human with the Twilight's Hammer found in Darkshore.
Hex Mix is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for un-hexing all of the potential hex victims in Zul'Aman on Heroic difficulty.

__NOTOC__ High Cultist Azennios is a human associated with the Twilight's Hammer clan. He can be found at the Seat of the Chosen in Mount Hyjal, attempting to smooth over relations with the ogres of the cult by talking with Karr'gonn.

Hideous Amalgamations are bound fire elementals that are spawned by killing the Corruption during the Spine of Deathwing encounter in the Dragon Soul. These unstable creatures are a patchwork of Elementium Armor fragments and pieces of the former Dragon's body held together by his molten blood.
A High Explosive Sheep is a mechanical sheep summoned by Zelfan, one of the 8 different NPCs that can be with Priestess Delrissa, the third boss in Magisters' Terrace.
High Adept Paosha is a pandaren found at Niuzao Temple of Townlong Steppes.
High Elder Cloudfall is a pandaren located in Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.
High-Explosive Gunpowder is created with Engineering (500); taught by trainers.
Hexmaster Bastoon is a jungle troll located at the Southern Barrens. He appears to be the Rageroar clan's second in command.

Heyman's Hubris is a shipwreck found off the southeast coast of the Isle of Thunder. Though upside down, there is an air pocket in the hull of the ship. Heyman's Hearthstone, found at Heyman's Hideaway in Zandalar, can be used to take the player to Heyman's Hubris.
Hexos is a legacy encounter in the Brawler's Guild and requires the use of a challenge card to fight.
Hidden Fog creatures are found in Watcher's Sanctum of the Throne of Thunder after all of the Roaming Fogs are killed. These creature will be replaced if the weekly quest appears here.
High-Oracle Soo-roo is the future self of the Oracle Orphan. He is encountered at the Bronze Dragonshrine.
__NOTOC__ Hibernus the Sleeper is a rare plagued bear found sleeping in the hills to the southwest of the Scarlet Watchtower in Tirisfal Glades.
Hexweave Bag is a 30-slot bag that can be crafted by tailors.
High Command is the name given to refer to the supreme leadership and authority of several armies, including the Alliance of Lordaeron, Alliance and modern Horde.
High Councilor Vareg was an ogre that served under Imperator Mar'gok. He accompanied Mar'gok along with Ko'ragh to parley with at Grommashar, where he died while fighting orc warlocks in a pit.
__NOTOC__ Hexu's Amplifying Helm is a world drop from Pandaria mobs.

Hexweave Essence is crafted with Tailoring (1); taught by Pattern: Hexweave Essence. The recipe is sold for 5 x Secret of Draenor Tailoring from the tailoring vendor at Lunarfall / Frostwall (requires the Tailoring Emporium building), and Stormshield / Warspear in Ashran.
__NOTOC__ A Hidden Text Scroll is a by-product of the Inscription skill-up item Tattered Scroll.
__NOTOC__ High Councilor Mal'gris is an ogre located at the Throne of the Imperator in Highmaul. He is the High Councilor of the Gorian War Council.

Hidden Marsh Ruins is an underground ruin located within Zorammarsh in Tanaan Jungle which leads to the Shrine of the Blazing Crusader. Little else is known about the place itself other than it was once part of an arakkoan shrine. The surviving arakkoa within the place belong to an expeditionary group that met an unfortunate end. The entrance to the area is located at in Tanaan Jungle.
Heyzzle Veinripp is an goblin follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
High Explosive Grenades are provided for Impalement Insurance.

.]] High Commander Michael Goodchilde is a human located at the Crusader's Chapel in the Scarlet Monastery during The Scarlet Assault questline. After the death of High Inquisitor Whitemane, Goodchilde took the remaining Scarlet Crusaders under his wing. He is described as a zealot, murderer, and a hardened knight who has dedicated his life to the eradication of the undead. He fell in battle against the Deathlord of the Ebon Blade, who sought to revive Whitemane as a horsewoman during the Burning Legion's third invasion of Azeroth.

The Hidden Pools are a set of pools on top of a bluff in Val'sharah. They feed the waterfalls and rivers below. Wisps attuned with the forest can increase the maturation of saplings on the edges of the pools into trees.
Hibernating Growth was a Guardian druid honor talent, available at rank 19.

Heyman's End is a closed cave in the waters in the northern Gloaming Reef in Val'sharah. The cave can only be entered via the Strange Whirlpool that appears when the world quest Into the Whirlpool is active. Heyman's Journal can be found there.

difficulty, High Botanist Tel'arn is split into three images from the start of the fight. This inverts the order of the fight compared to Normal/Heroic mode.]] High Botanist Tel'arn is a nightborne located in the Nighthold.
The Hidden Corridor is a secret passageway from Glorious Goods to the Hall of Shadows below Dalaran. It is only available to rogues.
Hexpriests are jungle trolls located inside the Windrunner's Sanctuary in Dalaran and the Netherlight Temple. They later appeared in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore as well as on the Vindicaar.
Hidden Potential is an achievement earned for obtaining a hidden artifact appearance.

present.]] The Hidden Cell is a secret prison found under the Saurok Creation Pit in Throne of Thunder. It is found after walking through two sets of doors beneath the Pit. The cell's only prisoner, Ra-den, is found chained to its walls.
Hidden Blade is an Outlaw rogue artifact trait. It is linked to the Blade Dancer and Fatebringer (artifact trait) traits.
Hideous Corruption is an Affliction warlock artifact trait. It is linked to the Wrath of Consumption (artifact trait) and Shadowy Incantations traits.
High Elf Boat Partygoers are high elves located at the Shimmering Deep in Thousand Needles.
Hexweaver Jakunda is a jungle troll located at Andorhal in The Deaths of Chromie scenario.
The Hidden Passageway is a small staircase in Black Rook Hold. It connects the Grand Sepulcher to the Chamber of War. A pair of bookcases disguise this passage in the Chamber of War.
Hidden Assassins can be found in Stormheim. They only spawn during The Reluctant Queen, where they are sent by Odyn to assassinate Sigryn.
Hidden Huntresses can be found in Stormheim. They only spawn during The Reluctant Queen, where they are sent by Odyn to assassinate Sigryn.
Hidden Wyrmtongue Caches are found outdoors in the Broken Shore.
The High Elven Tent is a placable tent that provides a stat bonus if rested in.
Hexbound Constructs are wicker brutes located in Arom's Crossing in Drustvar.
Hexcrazed Does are deer located at the Glenbrook Hunting Grounds in Drustvar.
Hexthrailed Villagers were humans located in Drustvar during development. Their ID was reused by Briarwood Sentry.
Hexed Bramblebacks are bramblebears located in the Crimson Forest in Drustvar.
Hexed Ravens are ravens located at the Crimson Forest in Drustvar.
Hexthralled Guardsmen are humans located at the Watchman's Rise in Drustvar.
Hexthralled Crossbowmen are humans located at the Watchman's Rise in Drustvar.
Hexthralled Falconers are humans located at the Corlain Aviary in Drustvar.
Hexthralled Halberdiers are humans located at the Pikeman's Ridge in Drustvar.

The High Gate is the great bridge that leads from the entrance of the Halls of Valor to the Hearth of Revelry. All challengers seeking entry to Odyn's halls as part of their trials must first pass through these gates, which are watched over and protected by their Guardian, Hymdall.
Hexcrazed Greatstags are stags located at the Glenbrook Hunting Grounds in Drustvar.
Hexed Howlers are wolves located at Carver's Harbor in Drustvar.
High-value Targets is an achievement earned for killing the rare creatures in Ashran.

Heyman's Hideaway is a sunken ship off the coast of Vol'dun. The hideaway is where the Abyssal Horn is found. The Writhing Leviathan can be seen far below the horn. The Highborne (or quel'dorei, meaning "children of noble birth" in Darnassian), were the upper class and a sect of the ancient night elf civilization composed of the favored servitors of Queen Azshara. The Highborne were largely responsible for the War of the Ancients, and most of those Highborne who had allied with the demons and survived the war were turned into satyrs or naga. Those that allied with the Kaldorei Resistance before the last battle of the war found themselves exiled from Kalimdor, and eventually became the high elves of the Eastern Kingdoms. .]] High Interrogator Gerstahn is an elite human member of the Twilight's Hammer clan found in the center of the Detention Block in Blackrock Depths. She is the only person in the prison area that holds a Prison Cell Key to all of the cells.

The High Priestess of Thaurissan is an elite Dark Iron dwarf found in the Blackrock Depths. Prior to , she appeared in place of Princess Moira Bronzebeard when all group members had completed Moira's quests.

The High Rise (or the high rise) is the top of Thunder Bluff's central mesa and contains the home of High Chieftain Baine Bloodhoof. Outside of the High Chieftain's quarters, Thunder Bluff's populace can witness important decisions and fateful events in an open-air auditorium. It contains a crude amphitheater around a bonfire. Professional trainers for cooking and fishing can also be found here. It connects to the middle rise and lower rise through the wind rider roost, and to Hunter Rise and Elder Rise by separate rope bridges. This is the only one of the three central rises to not contain a lift to the plains of Mulgore below.
